sources.title: Demo: Keep your PIN and OTP private
chunks: Official agencies and banks never ask you to share your PIN, OTP or password by SMS, WhatsApp or phone call.
If someone asks for your PIN or OTP, stop, do not reply, and contact the official helpline or website.

sources.title: Demo: Relief payment messages
chunks: Genuine relief payments are not released after you click a link in a message or pay a processing fee.
To check a relief payment, use the official website or visit an official office, and do not trust links sent by SMS.

sources.title: Demo: Photos of documents
chunks: Take document photos in good light, flat, with all four corners visible. Blurred or cropped photos may be sent for manual review.
